capabilities: Log time blocks by dragging across a grid timeline
Read and write events as plain Markdown lines under a heading
Summarize tracked time in a Work Insights dashboard
Follow the core Daily Notes folder and date format
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins browser; install by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugin folder. The plugin reads and updates daily notes but does not create them, and most commits since the fork are AI-written.
intentEvidence: A fork of seongchan/DailyWorkLog by SeongChan Hong, used under the MIT License.
problem: Tracking where the day went in Obsidian usually means frontmatter or a separate app, and daily notes offer no timeline view of logged hours.

relations.evidence: A fork of seongchan/DailyWorkLog by SeongChan Hong, used under the MIT License.

summary: Sidebar grid timeline that logs time blocks as plain Markdown lines in daily notes and summarizes tracked time per category.
